title: Flow actions: a `type: 'flow'` action cannot navigate to the record its run created — `onSuccess` is refused on flow actions and the run's response carries `output: {}`
body:
> **Premise checked before dispatch** (domain:spec seat 2, 2026-10-26): readings and corrections in comment 6409899481 (https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/25800#issuecomment-6409899481). The goal below is unchanged.

Filing class: ③ capability gap, filed at destination by the hotclm director seat under the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotclm#99 item 3 (batch 5, letter B, 2026-10-25). Unlabelled, no assignee; the objectstack seat triages.

## Symptom (hotclm, `@objectstack/*` 18.1.0 and 17.7.0)

`clm_contract` has a `type: 'flow'` header action `start_renewal` (target flow `renewal_start`, F12). Pressing it creates the renewal draft (`renewed_from` set) and toasts the `successMessage`, but the user stays on the old contract's record page with nothing to click: no link in the toast, no navigation. A second press is refused by the flow ("already has a renewal draft MSA-2026-0018"), so the only way to the draft is the list view.

## Why the app cannot declare it

- `onSuccess.navigate` exists and can read `${result.id}`, but `ON_SUCCESS_EXECUTORS = new Set(['api', 'script'])` (`packages/spec/src/ui/action-on-success-executor.ts:64`): `ActionSchema` refuses `onSuccess` on a `flow` action. 17.7.0 refused at parse ("if that capability is needed, it is a spec proposal"); 18.1.0 refuses with the flow-specific message ("would follow the flow's start, not a result … move the hop onto an `api` or `script` action").
- Even the response has nothing to navigate to: both `POST /api/v1/automation/renewal_start/trigger` (what the console sends) and `POST /api/v1/actions/clm_contract/start_renewal` answer `{ success: true, output: {}, successMessage }`. The `create_record` node's `outputVariable` is not an `isOutput` flow variable, so the new record's id never reaches the caller.
- The console (`ActionRunner.handlePostExecution`) would perform `onSuccess` after any executor, but no validated flow action can carry the key; `judgeFlowLaunch`'s done arm returns `{ success, data, reload }` only.
- Re-authoring the flow as a `script`/`api` action would reshape app metadata to dodge the gap, which the hotclm maintainer's standing rule forbids (「平台的问题就等平台」).

Measured by the hotclm dev on `origin/main e798190` (17.7.0) and read in the 18.1.0 spec dist; report: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotclm/issues/99#issuecomment-6392790257, seat analysis https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotclm/issues/99#issuecomment-6392812609.

## Expected capability

An autolaunched flow started from a record action should be able to hand a record back to the console, and the action should be able to navigate to it. One shape that fits the existing pieces:

1. The flow run's response carries the flow's `isOutput` variables under `output` (today it is `{}` even when the flow declares outputs; if that is a flow-authoring gap rather than a runtime one, say which).
2. `ON_SUCCESS_EXECUTORS` admits `flow` when the flow completes synchronously (no screen, no pause), with `${result.output.<var>}` interpolation, so `onSuccess: { navigate: '/apps/clm/clm_contract/record/${result.output.renewal_id}' }` is declarable.

Either half alone is enough for a related-list fallback to become a link; both are needed for the "press, land on the draft" experience.

## Dedupe

Searched objectstack issues for flow action post-success navigation / onSuccess on flow / flow output in the action response: #25458 is about the `navigate` path form on api/script actions, #20296 is the liveness grading of `onSuccess.navigate`, #14244 is `recordLoadDenied` on flow actions. None asks for a flow action to navigate to a record the run produced.
